test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In which of the following articles, “Laws inconsistent with or in derogation of the fundamental rights” is mentioned?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 13**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 13,** is the only option that **directly mentions laws inconsistent with or in derogation** of fundamental rights.
 
• Article 13 states that any law that is inconsistent with or in derogation of the fundamental rights shall be void.
 
• Article 12 of the Indian Constitution talks about the definition of the term "State".
 
• Article 15 prohibits discrimination on the basis of religion, race, caste, sex, or place of birth.
 
• Article 14 provides for equality before the law and equal protection of laws.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The question asks about the article that mentions laws inconsistent with or in derogation of fundamental rights, which is clearly mentioned in Article 13.
 
• Article 12 is related to the definition of the term "State" and has no relevance to the question.
 
• Article 15 talks about the prohibition of discrimination and does not mention laws inconsistent with fundamental rights.
 
• Article 14 provides for equality before the law and equal protection of laws, but does not specifically mention laws inconsistent with fundamental rights.
